name: com.thezebra/insurance
title: The Zebra
description: Compare car insurance quotes from top carriers and buy online with The Zebra, the comparison site.

tools.name: zebra_start_session
tools.description:
Start a new car insurance quote. Call this once, before any other quote tool, and pass the returned
quote_handle to every later tool call for this quote.

agent_identifier.description: Identifier for the product agent hosting this MCP session (for example muse, grokbot, dots). The calling agent or model must set this from its own runtime identity—do not ask the end user and do not pass through free-text the user typed.

tools.name: zebra_get_rc1_rates
tools.description:
Get estimated auto insurance rates (RC1 quotes) for the user, from the carriers they can buy from online on
The Zebra.

Call zebra_start_session first and pass its quote_handle. Usually takes about 30 seconds: wait for the result
rather than calling again or starting a new session. On UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, retry once with the same quote_handle.

Show each quote's carrier, monthly price, down payment and policy term, and say the prices are estimates.

A carrier may quote higher or lower coverage than requested; each quote's coverage_differences lists what differs.
When you show a quote with differences, tell the user what they are: the price is for the quoted coverage, not the
requested one.

Pass the quote_id of the quote the user picks to zebra_get_rate_action to learn how to continue. Calling this again
for the same session re-rates the quote with the new details and replaces the earlier quotes, so their quote_ids
stop working. Nothing is bought and no policy changes: to compare against the earlier details, call again with
them. Quotes are live, so prices may differ from before; don't tell the user the earlier prices still hold.
Failures return a JSON error with a code, whether retrying may help, and any problems with specific user_responses
fields. NO_QUOTES means no carrier has a quote the user can buy online on The Zebra, and its reason says why.
It comes with an agency_phone: tell the user why in plain words and give them agency_phone and the agency
hours, where a licensed insurance agent can help them find coverage. Don't call again with the same details.

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

user_responses.description: The full set of the user's driver, vehicle and insurance answers RC1 needs. Before calling, ask a currently insured user for their current bodily injury limits. Leave them out only if the user doesn't know them; never guess. When they're left out, The Zebra estimates them, so tell the user the quotes assume estimated current limits, that the price may change once the carrier checks their current policy, and that you can requote if they find their limits.

coverage_package.description: The coverages to price the quotes at. Send it only when the user wants specific coverage or wants to match their current policy; otherwise leave it out, and quotes use The Zebra's recommended coverage for the user. Don't ask about coverage just to fill this in. Amounts are in dollars, sent as plain numbers (100000, not $100,000). Users give liability as three numbers in thousands: 100/300/100 means bodily_injury_per_person 100000, bodily_injury_per_accident 300000 and property_damage 100000. 'Full coverage' or a deductible means comprehensive and collision on that vehicle; a deductible like $1,000 sets both unless the user gives them separately. When the user brings up coverage, confirm what they left out before calling: which vehicles get comprehensive and collision, and whether uninsured motorist coverage should match their bodily injury limits. If the call fails with INVALID_ARGUMENTS, each detail names a missing or conflicting coverage and the values the state offers; ask the user to choose rather than picking for them.

tools.name: zebra_get_rate_action
tools.description:
Get the next step for the quote the user chose. Pass the quote_handle from zebra_start_session and the chosen
quote's quote_id from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

Follow recommended_next to continue buying in this chat. Its instruction says when to give the user the url
instead.

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

quote_id.description: The quote_id of the quote the user picked, from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

tools.name: zebra_get_rc2_questions
tools.description:
Get the questions the carrier needs answered before the user can buy the quote they picked.

Ask the questions in order. Ask a question if any of its visibility_conditions is met, or, when it has none,
if is_visible is true. Check this again after each answer, because an answer can make new questions appear. Of
the questions you'll ask, read back the ones with a current_value together and ask if any have changed; ask the
rest one by one. For a question with child_field_keys, send each part under its child key. Ask for the driver's
license number: the carrier needs it to give a final price in the chat.

Then call zebra_submit_rc2_answers once with the same quote_id and every answer, including the current_values the
user kept. If the user's driver or vehicle details change, call zebra_get_rc1_rates and this tool again: the
questions depend on them.

The driver's license number is required to submit. If the user won't give it, or you can't collect it, don't call
zebra_submit_rc2_answers. Give the user the url from zebra_get_rate_action to finish buying online, or tell them
they can call a licensed insurance agent at (833) 387-1743.

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

quote_id.description: The quote_id of the quote the user picked, from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

tools.name: zebra_submit_rc2_answers
tools.description:
Submit the user's answers to the questions from zebra_get_rc2_questions, all at once. This sends them to the
carrier, so confirm them with the user first.

On success, a licensed insurance agent at agency_phone finishes buying the policy with the user. Present
agency_call_message as written: it says whether the agency is open now or when it opens. Never tell the user to
call now when it says the agency is closed, and never promise a voicemail or a callback.
When continue_url is returned, also offer it: the user can finish online with a licensed insurance agent during
agency hours.
When price_status is in_progress, the carrier's final price is on its way: tell the user and follow
recommended_next.
If it fails with INVALID_ARGUMENTS, details names each answer that wasn't accepted: ask the user about just those,
then call again with every answer.
If it fails with an agency_phone, this quote can't be bought in chat right now. Call again if retryable is true.
Otherwise, or if it keeps failing, give the user agency_phone and the agency hours to finish with a licensed
insurance agent, or offer them another quote from zebra_get_rc1_rates.

If a VIN is rejected because it matches a different vehicle, ask the user whether the VIN or the vehicle is wrong.
For a wrong VIN, call again with the right one. For a wrong vehicle, call zebra_get_rc1_rates with the VIN's
vehicle only once the user agrees: the price changes, and they choose a quote again. Tell the user about each
vehicle_updates entry, and that the final price may differ from the earlier estimate. If you call
zebra_get_rc1_rates again, send the updated vehicle.

quote_handle.description: The quote_handle that zebra_start_session returned. It expires 24 hours after zebra_start_session; if a tool reports it unknown or expired, start a new session.

answers.description: Every answer, including the current_values the user kept, keyed by field_key (each part of a grouped question under its child_field_keys key). Answer a CHECKBOX question with a list of the chosen values, even when only one is chosen: ["Yes"], not "Yes".

tools.name: zebra_get_rc2_price
tools.description:
Get the carrier's final price for a quote after zebra_submit_rc2_answers.

The carrier usually returns the final price 3 to 5 minutes after the answers are submitted. Each call waits a while
for it.
While price_status is in_progress, keep calling this tool without waiting for the user.
If you have to stop while price_status is still in_progress, tell the user their final price isn't ready yet and
to ask you again in a minute.
If price_status is still in_progress 10 minutes after the answers were submitted, treat the price as unavailable.
When price_status is priced, present price as the quote's final price, in place of the earlier estimate, and
mention the other payment_plans if the user asks how to pay.
When price_status is unavailable, a licensed insurance agent gives the user the final price.
Either way, a licensed insurance agent finishes buying the policy with the user: by calling agency_phone, or
online at continue_url, by chat or over the phone, during agency hours. Present agency_call_message as written:
it says whether the agency is open now or when it opens, so never tell the user to call now when it says the
agency is closed.
If this tool fails with an agency_phone, call it again if retryable is true. Otherwise, or if it keeps failing,
the final price comes from a licensed insurance agent: give the user agency_phone and the agency hours.
